purpose: Comparator records for NYSC COURSE-066 and COURSE-004 Professional English. The governed catalogue publishes no module headings for these courses, so the records are shown without a competency matrix. Records describe documented curriculum only and do not establish equivalence, quality or labour demand.
status_note: No record has been human-verified yet. Every record must be checked against its official source by a researcher before publication.

country_group_gaps.sri_lanka: No Sri Lankan English-language standard or programme with inspectable curriculum content was verified on 2026-10-18: the NVQ portal lists a diploma-level standard titled 'Teaching English as a Second Language' (M80T003; listing only, not inspected), and the two Open University of Sri Lanka English programme pages that were read show programme descriptions but no module lists.
country_group_gaps.developing_emerging: No developing/emerging-economy English-language qualification with inspectable curriculum content was verified on 2026-10-18: TESDA's training-regulations listing contains no English-language qualification; DGT curricula and India's NQR were not searched for English-language qualifications.
